//comment: A 'franchise' is the durable identity stats are tracked against (AGENTS.md) — NOT an ESPN
teamId (which can be reused/reshuffled by ESPN across seasons) and NOT a manager (a franchise
can change hands and keep its history). This file is the ONLY source of franchise identity;
the normalizer never invents franchises from ESPN data. Run `npm run seed:suggest` after a
backfill to get a draft of this file grouped by owner SWID across every archived season.
Resolution order (franchise-map.ts resolveFranchise): for a given (season, espnTeamId), first
an explicit entry in this franchise's `espnTeamIds`, then a manager whose `espnOwnerSwid`
matches one of that ESPN team's owners AND whose [fromSeason, toSeason] window covers the
season. A team that resolves neither way is a HARD validation failure for that season.

franchises.notes: Example of a franchise that changed managers mid-history — both are listed, non-overlapping fromSeason/toSeason windows.
